chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey Ch 553: An Accidental Breakthrough to Late Core Formation
chapter_meta_description: Han Li is trapped, forced to digest a volatile wine. After a brush with death from an unstable treasure, he shocks himself by breaking through to late Core Formation.
og_title: He Escaped Death and Got a Promotion
og_description: Han Li faces exploding internal treasures, forced labor, and a suspicious wine. His reward? An unexpected cultivation breakthrough.
twitter_title: Prison Break, but the Escape Plan was an Accidental Promotion
twitter_description: Han Li accidentally breaks through to late Core Formation after nearly dying from an unstable magic item. The price was months of forced labor and a suspicious magic wine.

lore_anchors.definition: A powerful, single-use ice-attribute treasure Han Li swallowed months ago as a last resort, which he now keeps suppressed inside his body with lightning.
A potent but volatile wine concocted by the demon cultivator Feng Xi, forced upon Han Li to rapidly increase his cultivation base.
An extremely rare and precious liquid that instantly restores a cultivator's mana; Han Li uses it sparingly to fuel his accelerated Core Flame.
